import pandas as pd

# File paths for the source CSV files
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_85/test_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_85/test_1.csv"

# Load Source 0
# Schema: ['calaccess_committee_id', 'committee_name', 'calaccess_filing_id', 'date_received',
#          'contributor_lastname', 'contributor_firstname', 'contributor_city', 'contributor_state',
#          'contributor_zip', 'contributor_employer', 'contributor_occupation',
#          'contributor_is_self_employed', 'amount']
df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)

# Load Source 1
# Schema: ['ocd_prop_id', 'calaccess_prop_id', 'ccdc_prop_id', 'prop_name',
#          'ccdc_committee_id', 'calaccess_committee_id', 'committee_name', 'committee_position']
df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)

# Rename Source 1's committee_name to committee_name_x to match target schema
df1 = df1.rename(columns={"committee_name": "committee_name_x"})

# Rename Source 1's committee_position to committee_position (same name in target)
# committee_name_y will come from Source 0's committee_name

# We want to join Source 1 and Source 0 on calaccess_committee_id and committee_name / committee_name_x
# The target schema has both committee_name_x and committee_name_y columns:
# committee_name_x from Source 1 (committee_name renamed)
# committee_name_y from Source 0 (committee_name)

# Join keys:
# - calaccess_committee_id (both tables)
# - committee_name_x (df1) and committee_name (df0)

# To join on committee_name_x = committee_name, we need to join df1 and df0 on:
# df1.calaccess_committee_id == df0.calaccess_committee_id AND df1.committee_name_x == df0.committee_name

# Perform inner join to keep only matching rows
df_merged = pd.merge(
    df1,
    df0,
    how="inner",
    left_on=["calaccess_committee_id", "committee_name_x"],
    right_on=["calaccess_committee_id", "committee_name"],
    suffixes=("", "_y")
)

# Now build the target DataFrame with all required columns in order and correct types

# Target schema:
# ['ocd_prop_id': string,
#  'calaccess_prop_id': integer,
#  'ccdc_prop_id': integer,
#  'prop_name': string,
#  'ccdc_committee_id': integer,
#  'calaccess_committee_id': integer,
#  'committee_name_x': string,
#  'committee_position': string,
#  'committee_name_y': string,
#  'calaccess_filing_id': integer,
#  'date_received': string,
#  'contributor_lastname': string,
#  'contributor_firstname': string,
#  'contributor_city': string,
#  'contributor_state': string,
#  'contributor_zip': string,
#  'contributor_employer': string,
#  'contributor_occupation': string,
#  'contributor_is_self_employed': boolean,
#  'amount': float]

# Extract and convert columns accordingly

# ocd_prop_id: from df1 (string)
ocd_prop_id = df_merged["ocd_prop_id"].astype(str)

# calaccess_prop_id: from df1 (integer)
calaccess_prop_id = pd.to_numeric(df_merged["calaccess_prop_id"], errors='coerce').astype('Int64')

# ccdc_prop_id: from df1 (integer)
ccdc_prop_id = pd.to_numeric(df_merged["ccdc_prop_id"], errors='coerce').astype('Int64')

# prop_name: from df1 (string)
prop_name = df_merged["prop_name"].astype(str)

# ccdc_committee_id: from df1 (integer)
ccdc_committee_id = pd.to_numeric(df_merged["ccdc_committee_id"], errors='coerce').astype('Int64')

# calaccess_committee_id: from df1 (integer)
calaccess_committee_id = pd.to_numeric(df_merged["calaccess_committee_id"], errors='coerce').astype('Int64')

# committee_name_x: from df1 (string)
committee_name_x = df_merged["committee_name_x"].astype(str)

# committee_position: from df1 (string)
committee_position = df_merged["committee_position"].astype(str)

# committee_name_y: from df0 (string) - this is df_merged["committee_name"] (from right table)
committee_name_y = df_merged["committee_name"].astype(str)

# calaccess_filing_id: from df0 (integer)
calaccess_filing_id = pd.to_numeric(df_merged["calaccess_filing_id"], errors='coerce').astype('Int64')

# date_received: from df0 (string)
date_received = df_merged["date_received"].astype(str)

# contributor_lastname: from df0 (string)
contributor_lastname = df_merged["contributor_lastname"].astype(str)

# contributor_firstname: from df0 (string)
contributor_firstname = df_merged["contributor_firstname"].astype(str)

# contributor_city: from df0 (string)
contributor_city = df_merged["contributor_city"].astype(str)

# contributor_state: from df0 (string)
contributor_state = df_merged["contributor_state"].astype(str)

# contributor_zip: from df0 (string)
contributor_zip = df_merged["contributor_zip"].astype(str)

# contributor_employer: from df0 (string)
contributor_employer = df_merged["contributor_employer"].astype(str)

# contributor_occupation: from df0 (string)
contributor_occupation = df_merged["contributor_occupation"].astype(str)

# contributor_is_self_employed: from df0 (boolean)
# The source might be boolean or string, ensure boolean dtype
contributor_is_self_employed = df_merged["contributor_is_self_employed"].map(
    {True: True, False: False, 'True': True, 'False': False, 'true': True, 'false': False}
).fillna(False).astype(bool)

# amount: from df0 (float)
amount = pd.to_numeric(df_merged["amount"], errors='coerce').astype(float)

# Construct the final DataFrame
target_df = pd.DataFrame({
    "ocd_prop_id": ocd_prop_id,
    "calaccess_prop_id": calaccess_prop_id,
    "ccdc_prop_id": ccdc_prop_id,
    "prop_name": prop_name,
    "ccdc_committee_id": ccdc_committee_id,
    "calaccess_committee_id": calaccess_committee_id,
    "committee_name_x": committee_name_x,
    "committee_position": committee_position,
    "committee_name_y": committee_name_y,
    "calaccess_filing_id": calaccess_filing_id,
    "date_received": date_received,
    "contributor_lastname": contributor_lastname,
    "contributor_firstname": contributor_firstname,
    "contributor_city": contributor_city,
    "contributor_state": contributor_state,
    "contributor_zip": contributor_zip,
    "contributor_employer": contributor_employer,
    "contributor_occupation": contributor_occupation,
    "contributor_is_self_employed": contributor_is_self_employed,
    "amount": amount
})

# Reset index to default integer index
target_df.reset_index(drop=True, inplace=True)

# Save the result to the target CSV file
target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_85/target_multisource_cot.csv"
target_df.to_csv(target_path, index=False)
